# Omaha Hi-Lo Poker

Free browser Omaha Hi-Lo 8 or Better with bots or friends. No registration.
Humans play on the website; MCP only prepares tables and reads safe status.

- Integration and connection instructions: https://omahahilopoker.com/ai
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://omahahilopoker.com/mcp
- Registry manifest: https://omahahilopoker.com/mcp-server.json
- Rules: https://omahahilopoker.com/rules

Tools: create_poker_table, get_play_link (creates a new table), get_table_status,
get_game_info. Discover full input schemas using MCP tools/list.
Return join_url unchanged, including its fragment. First joiner becomes host.
Private invitations grant a new seat, never an existing player's identity.
Connect and approve this server in your MCP client; this document does not
guarantee automatic discovery, registry publication or ChatGPT availability.
